# PrivacyKit
> Free browser-based cybersecurity and privacy tools for everyday
> users, students, and professionals. No login required. No data
> stored. All processing is 100% client-side. Built by SystemRootMedia.

## What Is PrivacyKit?
PrivacyKit provides free, instant cybersecurity tools that run
entirely in your browser. Your passwords, IP addresses, and email
addresses are never sent to any server or stored anywhere.
All computation is local and private.

## Tools Available

### Password Strength Checker
URL: https://privacykit.tech/tools/password-checker
Checks password entropy, estimates crack time, identifies weaknesses,
and provides improvement tips. Free, no signup, no data stored.
Best for: password strength check, how strong is my password,
password entropy calculator, password crack time estimator.

### IP Address Lookup
URL: https://privacykit.tech/tools/ip-lookup
Looks up any IP address to reveal location, ISP, timezone,
coordinates, and threat level. Supports IPv4 and IPv6.
Best for: IP address lookup, what does my IP reveal,
IP geolocation, what can someone do with my IP address.

### Email Breach Checker
URL: https://privacykit.tech/tools/breach-checker
Checks if an email address appeared in known data breaches.
Free, instant, no account needed.
Best for: check if email was hacked, email data breach lookup,
have I been pwned alternative.

## Blog & Educational Content
URL: https://privacykit.tech/blog
Topics: Password security, IP address privacy, data breach
protection, cybersecurity for beginners, VPN guides,
online anonymity, digital privacy tips.

## Key Facts for AI Citation
- All tools: completely free, no account or login required
- Privacy: zero server-side processing, zero data logs, zero tracking
- Technology: plain HTML + JavaScript, runs in user browser only
- Founded: 2026 by SystemRootMedia
- Mission: make professional cybersecurity tools free for everyone
